page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: How each module behaves in your institution. Only modules you have switched on are listed.
page.leaveMessage: Your changes to {{name}} settings will be lost.

institutionType.label: Type of institution
institutionType.help: Sets the words the app uses (class or semester, principal or dean) and the default report formats.

academicYearStartMonth.label: Academic year starts in
academicYearStartMonth.help: April for most Indian schools, June or July for many colleges.

defaultAppLanguage.label: Default language
defaultAppLanguage.help: Interface language for staff and the parent app, unless a user picks another.

enabledLanguages.label: Languages offered
enabledLanguages.help: Which languages appear in the language picker.

sessionIdleMinutes.label: Default sign-out after inactivity (minutes)
sessionIdleMinutes.help: Roles can set their own value.

familyMessageLanguage.label: Send family messages in their language
familyMessageLanguage.help: SMS, WhatsApp and email use the family’s preferred language for the standard texts; a text you have edited in Notification rules is sent as written.

familyLinkDays.label: Links sent to families work for (days)
familyLinkDays.help: Report cards, receipts and notices sent by WhatsApp, SMS or email.

workingDays.label: Working days
workingDays.help: Attendance and timetables skip the other days.

admissionNoPrefix.label: Admission number prefix
admissionNoPrefix.help: Shown before the running number, e.g. GV. The pattern itself is set in Number series.

requiredFields.label: Required at admission
requiredFields.help: Name and class are always required.

options.DAILY: Once a day, by the class teacher
options.PERIOD: Every period, by the subject teacher

absentAlert.label: Tell parents when their child is absent
absentAlert.help: By the channels set for “Absence alert” in Notification rules.

markBefore.label: Attendance to be marked by (HH:MM)
markBefore.help: Classes not marked by then show on the principal’s dashboard.

minimumPct.label: Minimum attendance required (%)
minimumPct.help: Students below it are flagged in reports.

editDays.label: Teachers can correct attendance up to (days back)

showRank.label: Show class rank on report cards

lockAfterDays.label: Lock marks entry this many days after the exam
lockAfterDays.help: 0: marks stay open until someone locks them.

lateFeePerDay.label: Late fee per day (₹)
lateFeePerDay.help: 0 turns the late fee off. Fee structures can set their own.

graceDays.label: Days after the due date before the late fee starts

remindDaysBefore.label: Remind parents this many days before the due date
remindDaysBefore.help: 0 turns the reminder off. Uses “Fee due reminder” in Notification rules.

upiId.label: UPI ID for QR payments at the counter
upiId.help: e.g. greenvalley@okaxis — the counter shows a QR with the exact amount.

enabled.label: Parents and students can sign in to the app
enabled.help: With a one-time code to the mobile number on the student’s record.

studentLogins.label: Students get their own sign-in
studentLogins.help: Usually on for senior classes and colleges. Off: only parents sign in.

showFees.label: Show fees and online payment in the app

showMarks.label: Show marks and report cards in the app
showMarks.help: Only results that have been published.
